Vakul Singh What did IIT roorkee pay you ? As far as I know you paid for
learning right ? You paid for food, hostel etc. Internship doesn't give you
breakeven. Please don't say I have food expenses. So, if you write expenses,
ever company tells you expenses !! At the end of the day, at a startup, your
compensation depends on how much value you add to company !! Having hired
multiple interns over 7 years from IITs as well, I can tell you, a company
doesn't even get 10k worth value when an intern works for us. As a mentor or
friend - I advice you this. Never negotiate pay saying - I have food and
shopping expenses , so pay me this !!. Instead tell - I can write this code,
which adds this much value so pay me this !!

others ! Correct me if am wrong doctor ! (edited)
